title: Conormal sheaf of a closed immersion under (flat) base change
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$, $i':Z'\to X'$, $g:X\to X'$, $f:Z\to Z'$ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial] ($i,i'$ closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion], $g\circ i=i'\circ f$), with canonical map $c:f^*\mathcal C_{Z'/X'}\to\mathcal C_{Z/X}$ of conormal sheaves. Assume the square is cartesian, i.e. $(Z,i,f)$ is a fibre product of $g$ and $i'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $c$ is surjective; if moreover $g$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], then $c$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules. (Affine locally: for a ring map $R'\to R$ and an ideal $I'\subset R'$ with $I=I'R$, the map $I'/I'^2\otimes_{R'}R\to I/I^2$ is surjective, and bijective when $R'\to R$ is flat.)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 0473 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial-flat), case of closed immersions, with its proof; the ideal of the base-changed closed immersion is Schemes, Lemma 01JU (schemes-lemma-fibre-product-immersion) (1)
